constraints: paramObj.formula (a 4D.Function callback) is mandatory; it is invoked when the export completes and receives the area name, the exported 4D.Blob, and a reference object.
Exporting/importing 4D View Pro areas as blobs is fast and memory-efficient compared to file-based export.

paramObj supports several Boolean include* options (includeAutoMergedCells, includeBindingSource, includeCalcModelCache, includeEmptyRegionCells, includeFormulas, includeStyles, includeUnusedNames) and saveAsView, each with documented defaults.

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Asynchronously exports the 4D View Pro document attached to an area into a 4D.Blob according to export options, delivering the resulting blob to a mandatory callback method.
